description: Large herbivorous mammal native to South and Southeast Asia.
long_description: The Asian elephant is the largest living land animal in Asia. Smaller-eared than its African relatives, it survives in fragmented populations across South and Southeast Asia, from grassland to tropical forest. Herds are led by a matriarch and communicate through low-frequency rumbles. Habitat loss and human–elephant conflict have driven steep declines, and the species is listed as Endangered.
